name: neon
description: Applies Finnomena's brand so any employee's vibe-coded apps, UI mockups and artwork follow company branding. Ships neon-create (builds on the Neon base, or in an app already on the Coinbase Design System), neon-redesign (colors and typography through CSS variables), neon-audit (recommends a theming depth for an existing project), neon-review (read-only, evidence-backed UI review), neon-block (draws Brand Artwork such as ads, posts and covers with the Block engine, through the finno tools) and neon-deck (builds a deck of 16:9 slides as one HTML file, with its cover, closing and Patterns drawn by the same engine).
